description: This header defines the interface class DobbyInterface for managing containers through a proxy, including methods for starting, stopping, listing, and handling container state changes, as well as event handling callbacks.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class providing container management functionalities such as start, stop, pause, resume, and event notifications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the interface with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the interface.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernate a container with options.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem in a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback for when a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback for when a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for when a container's state changes.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Callback for a verification failure.

ctags.name: mEventListenerId
ctags.pattern: /^            int mEventListenerId; \/\/ Dobby event listener ID$/
